subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Session Architecture: Shared LLM + Isolated Sessions + Public Knowledge Base

question: Should #48874 remain the umbrella multi-session architecture tracker, or should maintainers close/split it after naming narrower canonical issues for session families, routing, UI lifecycle, and memory privacy?
rationale: The remaining work changes product architecture, config surface, persistent state, channel behavior, and security boundaries, so automation cannot choose the permanent model safely.

options.title: Keep umbrella and stage slices
options.body: Use #48874 for the overarching architecture decision while landing only narrower maintainer-approved issues for each subsystem.

options.title: Split then close umbrella
options.body: Create or bless canonical protocol/store, UI, memory/security, and channel-routing issues, then close #48874 with the split map.

options.title: Reject broad architecture
options.body: Close the RFC as out of current scope and keep only existing narrower bug or feature reports.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and stage slices
recommendation.body: Use #48874 for the overarching architecture decision while landing only narrower maintainer-approved issues for each subsystem.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent session lifecycle and Control UI history points to this owner as the best available reviewer for the product split.
